repository.name: @webex/plugin-meetings
repository.purpose: A Webex JavaScript SDK plugin that manages meeting discovery, lifecycle, realtime state, participants, media, and in-meeting capabilities.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-meetings package entry
entrypoints: import {Meeting, CONSTANTS, REACTIONS, MeetingInfoV2, RemoteMedia, TriggerProxy, getAIEnablementApprover} from '@webex/plugin-meetings'
public_interfaces.audience: applications and the webex SDK bundles
public_interfaces.notes: package.json main is dist/index.js and types dist/types/index.d.ts, both built from src/index.ts. Importing it registers the meetings plugin and three request interceptors and loads @webex/internal-plugin-identity. A symbol below src/ is public only when this entry exports it or a public object such as webex.meetings or Meeting exposes it. Contract IDs plugin-meetings-sdk and meetings-plugin in .sdd/manifest.json.

public_interfaces.name: webex.meetings and Meeting objects
public_interfaces.notes: Meetings owns registration, discovery, and the meeting collection; Meeting (src/meeting/index.ts) owns one meeting's lifecycle, media, controls, and events. Feature controllers (breakouts, simultaneousInterpretation, annotation, aiEnableRequest, webinar, members) hang off Meeting. Contract IDs meetings-collection-api, meeting-api and the feature *-api IDs.

public_interfaces.name: in-process events
public_interfaces.notes: EVENT_TRIGGERS plus the BREAKOUTS.EVENTS, INTERPRETATION.EVENTS, and AI_ENABLE_REQUEST.EVENTS families, the annotation constants in src/annotation/constants.ts, and the reachability inline literals. The full emitted-event inventory, the declared-but-not-emitted list, and payload catalogs are in docs/architecture.md Public and consumer surfaces. Contract ID meetings-events.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: build:src compiles src to dist with webex-legacy-tools and then runs build, which emits dist/types with tsc and runs build:assets to copy assets to dist/assets. test:unit runs mocha through webex-legacy-tools with no coverage threshold. test:browser runs karma over test/integration/spec. test:broken chains style, unit, integration, and browser runs and is not a manifest command.

refresh_with: update alongside a change to package boundaries, exports, events, or dependencies in the same commit
update the docs/README.md beside the changed module in the same commit as the behavior change

recommended: add or update the test/unit/spec case beside the changed module; some specs import the package by name and load dist, so build first
check the export list, the event inventory, and the contract index in docs/architecture.md
keep the E2EE asset filename version in step with E2EE_WASM_ASSET in src/e2ee/E2eeManager.ts

change_impact.notes: Exports are semver-sensitive; prefer additive changes and update docs/architecture.md Public and consumer surfaces.

affects: event names and wire values seen by applications
change_impact.notes: Never silently change an event literal or wire value; add the event to the emitted-event inventory or the declared-but-not-emitted list.

affects: every Locus request made through webex.request
change_impact.notes: Retries stay bounded: a Locus 429 or 503 is retried once and the data-channel token refresh retries once.

glossary.definition: Client object coordinating one Webex meeting lifecycle and media session (src/meeting/index.ts).
Registered plugin and collection-level coordinator, reached as webex.meetings (src/meetings/index.ts).
Webex meeting-state service and payload projected into the client by LocusInfo (src/locus-info/index.ts).
RTCWeb Offer/Answer Protocol, the offer/answer signaling used during media negotiation (src/roap/index.ts).
Receive/send slot and remote-media management over a media connection (src/multistream).
Main/session-group state and controls for breakout sessions (src/breakouts).
Webinar state/data-channel flow before public webcast (src/webinar/index.ts).
Personal Meeting Room resolved or claimed for a user (src/personal-meeting-room).
Incremental Locus synchronization by dataset hash comparison, reconciled into the same projection as full state and deltas (src/hashTree/hashTreeParser.ts).
glossary.notes: full state, delta, and hash tree are alternate Locus synchronization forms for one projection.

glossary.definition: SDK device and Mercury registration through webex.meetings.register(), not npm package registration.
Joining meeting state; adding media is a distinct staged operation that may follow join.
glossary.notes: leave exits the local participant; end for all is a privileged remote mutation.

glossary.definition: An in-memory Ampersand or package collection (src/common/collection.ts), not persistence.
Contributing Source Identifier used to associate media and participants.
Best-effort load of the E2EE WASM module after registration when enableE2ee is set and WASM is supported (src/e2ee/E2eeManager.ts).

evidence_rules.requirement: The script must exist in package.json scripts and the command must equal the manifest commands entry.
evidence_rules.notes: install and prebuild run at the workspace root.

evidence_rules.requirement: A symbol is public only when src/index.ts exports it or a public object exposes it.
evidence_rules.notes: Files under src/ that src/index.ts does not export are internal.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or test evidence.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not a rationale source for this package. README.md and UPGRADING.md are consumer context only; validate their examples against current source.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not present a declared EVENT_TRIGGERS constant as a live event without an emit site.
negative_guidance.why: media:quality, media:update, and meeting:aiEnableRequest are declared but never emitted.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not restore participant email as a roster convenience field.
negative_guidance.why: It was removed in version 0.109.0 to reduce PII; consumers resolve identity through the People API (README.md).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log tokens, authorization headers, participant PII, raw transcript or media, or full sensitive URLs.
negative_guidance.why: Logs and metrics leave the client (docs/architecture.md Security architecture).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add retries, polling, or retry budgets beyond the existing bounded ones.
negative_guidance.why: Locus hash-tree and sync calls are deliberately never retried during a sync storm (src/interceptors/locusRetry.ts).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not assume all caches are process-local.
negative_guidance.why: Reachability results and the join cookie persist in the host's bounded storage (src/reachability/index.ts).

high.expectation: Source and a unit case agree on the behavior being changed.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, as for the unspecified src/common, src/e2ee, and src/transcription folders. Pin current behavior with a unit case before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source, tests, nor a dependency's code settles the question. Stop and report the gap.
